name: Lesson 3 · Spin and land
intro: Rotation multiplies the score. Stop spinning in time to land clean.

goals.hint: Push the sticks opposite ways to spin the board, and crouch to spin faster. Stop the twist to land straight
goals.hintClassic: Launch big, then hold Q or E (LB / RB) to spin. Release with the nose pointing back down the line

goals.hint: A 540 lands fakie: that is fine, the judge accepts either way round
